note: For every tool the server classifies as a mutation, the work a successful call can leave undone (Q6, principle P5): leaves, naming the work and the answer fact that produces its follow_up step; none, saying why nothing is left; or exempt, with the issue that tracks what is not yet said. src/mcp/follow_ups.cpp derives each step from the fact, and the live harness fails a step a tool does not declare here.

anim_play_track.none: It changes a running game's playback, which nothing saves by design.

asset_configure_import.none: It writes the .import file and answers after the editor has reimported the asset from it.

asset_reimport.none: It is the editor's own import pass, and it answers after the pass is applied.

audio_add_bus.none: The editor's own bus-layout autosave writes the layout file, persisted_by_editor says whether it did, and limitation says why when it cannot.

audio_configure_bus.none: The editor's own bus-layout autosave writes the layout file, persisted_by_editor says whether it did, and limitation says why when it cannot.

blackboard_clear.none: The board is Didi's own file, written before the answer, and nothing else holds a copy of it.

blackboard_patch.none: The board is Didi's own file, written before the answer, and nothing else holds a copy of it.

blackboard_task_claim.none: The board is Didi's own file, written before the answer, and nothing else holds a copy of it.

blackboard_task_complete.none: The board is Didi's own file, written before the answer, and nothing else holds a copy of it.

blackboard_task_create.none: The board is Didi's own file, written before the answer, and nothing else holds a copy of it.

blackboard_task_update.none: The board is Didi's own file, written before the answer, and nothing else holds a copy of it.

blackboard_write.none: The board is Didi's own file, written before the answer, and nothing else holds a copy of it.

editor_redo.exempt: Whether a history step leaves the scene unsaved depends on where the saved version sits in the history, and the answer does not say; only Godot 4.7 can read it.

editor_reload_project.none: It asks the editor to scan its sources, which changes nothing that needs saving.

editor_save_scene.none: It writes the edited scene to disk, which is the save every scene edit names.

editor_undo.exempt: Whether a history step leaves the scene unsaved depends on where the saved version sits in the history, and the answer does not say; only Godot 4.7 can read it.

gridmap_export_mesh_library.exempt: It writes a file an attached editor is not told about, so the editor can hold an old copy, and none of save, rescan or restart is a claim it can make.

project_apply_changes.exempt: It writes files an attached editor is not told about, so the editor can hold old copies, and none of save, rescan or restart is a claim it can make.

project_export.none: Its output is an export artifact, which no running Godot loads from the project.

project_remove_input_action.none: The editor applies the change and saves project.godot itself; a game already running keeps the map it started with, as it keeps every project change.

project_rename_references.exempt: It rewrites files an attached editor is not told about, so the editor can hold old copies, and none of save, rescan or restart is a claim it can make.

project_set_input_action.none: The editor applies the change and saves project.godot itself; a game already running keeps the map it started with, as it keeps every project change.

project_set_setting.fact: written_to res://project.godot with no editor attached, or requires_editor_restart: true for a moved bus layout

resource_create.none: It reloads an attached editor's copy of the file it wrote, and editor_copy_reloaded says whether that happened.

runtime_checkpoint.none: It records the saved project files, and holds nothing anywhere unsaved.

runtime_explore_scene.none: It drives a running game, whose state nothing saves by design.

runtime_inject_input.none: It drives a running game, whose state nothing saves by design.

runtime_launch.none: It starts a game process, and the answer says how to reach it and how to end it.

runtime_recover_editor.none: It restarts the managed editor on the saved files, which is the whole of its work.

runtime_restore_checkpoint.none: It stops the managed editor before it replaces the files, so no editor holds an old copy of them.

runtime_set_paused.none: It drives a running game, whose state nothing saves by design.

runtime_step.none: It drives a running game, whose state nothing saves by design.

runtime_stop.none: It ends a game process, which leaves nothing behind to save.

runtime_watch_invariants.none: It watches a running game and changes nothing a caller would need to save.

scene_call_method.exempt: It runs project code in the editor, which can change anything, and the answer cannot say what that code left unsaved.

scene_close.none: It closes the scene, and refuses one with unsaved changes unless discard_unsaved asks to lose them.

scene_create.none: It saves the new scene before answering, as saved: true says, and opens it.

scene_open.none: Opening a scene changes nothing on disk or in any scene.

scene_pack_branch.none: It saves the packed scene itself, as saved: true says, and leaves the source branch as it was.

script_create.exempt: It writes a file an attached editor is not told about, so the editor can hold an old copy, and none of save, rescan or restart is a claim it can make.

script_patch_method.exempt: It rewrites a file an attached editor is not told about, so the editor can hold an old copy, and none of save, rescan or restart is a claim it can make.

signal_emit.exempt: It runs whatever the signal's connections call, which can change anything, and the answer cannot say what that left unsaved.

viewport_create_test_lab.exempt: It writes a scene file an attached editor is not told about, so the editor can hold an old copy, and none of save, rescan or restart is a claim it can make.

viewport_toggle_debug_draw.none: The debug hints live in the editor session that runs games and are read back after the change; no scene holds them.
